info.title: minimax-h3-image API
info.description: Create image tasks using AI models with support for multiple models and parameter configurations

post.description:
- MiniMax H3 Image (minimax-h3-image) supports text-to-image generation and image editing, with up to 16 reference images
- Output up to 20 million pixels: combine an aspect ratio with a 1K / 2K / 4K resolution tier, or specify width and height in pixels
- Asynchronous processing: use the returned task ID to [query the task](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail)
- Generated image links are valid for 24 hours. Save the results promptly

model.description: Image generation model name. The official channel offers better stability and control for commercial use

prompt.description:
Prompt describing the image to generate or how to edit the input images

**Length limits:**
- Up to `32,000` characters (counted as Unicode code points)
- When `prompt_extend` is `false`, only approximately the first `4096` tokens of the prompt take effect
prompt.example: A beautiful colorful sunset over the ocean

image_urls.description:
List of reference image URLs for image-to-image generation and image editing

**Notes:**
- Number of input images per request: `1~16`
- Maximum size per image: `64MB`
- Width and height of each image: `128` to `8192` px
- Aspect ratio of each image: longest side / shortest side must not exceed `4:1`
- Supported formats: `.jpeg`, `.jpg`, `.png`, `.webp`, `.heic`, `.heif`
- Image URLs must be directly accessible by the server or trigger a direct download (these URLs usually end in an image extension such as `.png` or `.jpg`)
- Reference images incur additional image input tokens in image-to-image generation and image editing

size.description:
Output image size. Supports **aspect ratios** and **explicit pixel dimensions**. Default: `auto`

**① Aspect ratio (recommended):** `X:Y`. Common ratios:

- `1:1`: square
- `1:2` / `2:1`: tall / wide
- `1:3` / `3:1`: extra tall / extra wide (at the 3:1 limit)
- `2:3` / `3:2`: standard portrait / landscape
- `3:4` / `4:3`: traditional portrait / landscape
- `4:5` / `5:4`: common social media formats
- `9:16` / `16:9`: mobile / desktop widescreen
- `9:21` / `21:9`: ultrawide formats

Other `X:Y` values are also supported: `X` and `Y` must be integers from `1` to `300`, with an aspect ratio `≤ 3:1`

**② Explicit pixel dimensions:** `WxH` (or `W×H`), such as `1024x1024`, `2720x1536`, `5472x3072`

- Pixel budget: `655,360 ≤ width × height ≤ 20,000,000` (approximately 0.65 MP to 20 MP)
- Aspect ratio: `≤ 3:1`

**③ `auto`:** the model chooses the aspect ratio automatically; the output area still follows the `resolution` tier

**Out-of-range sizes:**
- Sizes outside these limits return `400`; they are not automatically resized or rounded

resolution.description:
Resolution shortcut. Applies when `size` is `auto` or an aspect ratio; ignored when explicit pixel dimensions are used

**Pixel budget** (width and height are calculated from the target total pixel count and the `size` ratio):

- `1K`: ~1 MP (1024² = 1,048,576 pixels)
- `2K`: ~4 MP (2048² = 4,194,304 pixels)
- `4K`: ~16.8 MP (4096² = 16,777,216 pixels)

**Actual landscape / square output sizes** (portrait sizes swap the corresponding width and height; for example, `3:4` reverses `4:3`):

| Aspect ratio | 2K | 4K |
|---|---|---|
| `1:1` | 2048×2048 | 4096×4096 |
| `4:3` | 2368×1760 | 4736×3552 |
| `16:9` | 2720×1536 | 5472×3072 |
| `3:1` | 3552×1184 | 7104×2368 |

**Notes:**
- `1K` and `2K` use the same number of image output tokens (approximately `4,096` per image); `4K` uses approximately `16,384` per image. The returned `usage` is authoritative
- Values are case-insensitive

output_format.description:
Output image format. Default: `jpeg`

- `jpeg`: lossy compression, smaller files
- `png`: lossless
- `webp`: balance of file size and quality

**Note:**
- Transparent backgrounds are not supported

n.description:
Number of images to generate. Each image is billed separately

**Notes:**
- Both text input tokens and image input tokens scale proportionally with `n`
- If some images fail (for example, due to content safety checks), the task still completes with the successful images. The actual count is determined by `results` in the response, and billing follows the returned `usage`

prompt_extend.description:
Prompt enhancement: the model rewrites the prompt with more detail before generation. Default: `true`

**Notes:**
- Can only be set to `false` for text-to-image generation when `size` is an aspect ratio or explicit pixel dimensions
- Setting it to `false` when `size` is `auto` or `image_urls` is provided returns `400`
- When enabled, it adds approximately `2,300` to `3,800` text input tokens per image; when disabled, only the original prompt is counted

callback_url.description:
HTTPS callback address after task completion

**Callback Timing:**
- Triggered when task is completed, failed, or cancelled
- Sent after billing confirmation is completed

**Security Restrictions:**
- Only HTTPS protocol is supported
- Callback to internal IP addresses is prohibited (127.0.0.1, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, etc.)
- URL length must not exceed `2048` characters

**Callback Mechanism:**
- Timeout: `10` seconds
- Maximum `3` retries on failure (retries after `1` second/`2` seconds/`4` seconds)
- Callback response body format is consistent with the task query API response format
- Callback address returning 2xx status code is considered successful, other status codes will trigger retry

can_cancel.description: Whether the task can be cancelled
